faq.q1: Do I need to provide source code?
faq.a1: No. PenScore analyzes your compiled binary (APK or IPA) directly. No source code, no credentials, no server access needed.
faq.q2: How long does a scan take?
faq.a2: Most scans complete in under 3 minutes. Large apps with many native libraries may take up to 5 minutes.
faq.q3: Can I integrate PenScore into my CI/CD pipeline?
faq.a3: Yes. Professional and Enterprise plans include a REST API and webhook support. You can block builds that fall below your PenScore threshold automatically.
faq.q4: Is my APK or IPA stored after scanning?
faq.a4: Binaries are deleted from our servers within 24 hours of scan completion. Scan results and reports are retained according to your plan.
faq.q5: What compliance frameworks does PenScore cover?
faq.a5: PenScore maps findings to BDDK, KVKK, PCI-DSS mobile requirements, MASVS v2, OWASP Mobile Top 10, and GDPR. Enterprise plans support custom compliance rule sets.
faq.a6: Yes. No contracts, no cancellation fees. Cancel from your dashboard at any time.

hero.headline: We're Making Mobile Apps Safer for Everyone.
hero.subtext: PenScore was built by mobile developers who were frustrated by the lack of accessible, developer-friendly security tooling. We believe every team — not just those with dedicated security budgets — deserves to ship secure apps.

story.body:
The idea for PenScore started in 2023 when our founder, working as a senior Android developer at a fintech company, discovered a hardcoded API key in a production binary — one that had been sitting there for over a year. The manual security review process had missed it completely.

Existing tools were either too expensive for small teams, too complex to integrate, or too shallow to catch what mattered. So we built PenScore: a platform that does what a senior security engineer would do, automated and accessible to every developer.

Today PenScore scans thousands of apps every month, helping teams across fintech, banking, e-commerce, and healthcare ship with confidence.

v1.title: Developer-First
v1.desc: Security tooling should fit into developer workflows, not the other way around. PenScore is built to be integrated in minutes, not months.

v3.title: Transparency

v4.title: Continuous Improvement
v4.desc: The threat landscape evolves constantly. We ship new detection rules weekly and update our compliance mappings with every regulatory change.
